title: What monthly means hide
query: Using the supplied GLORYS12 daily near-surface temperature for 1993-2020 off California and Oregon (30-48 N, 130-116 W), determine how the variance of sea surface temperature is divided among time scales: shorter than a month, the seasonal cycle, and from year to year. Show where and in which seasons the variability within a month matters most, and give at least two worked examples of a conclusion that comes out differently from monthly means than from the daily data.
